Find funding for Doctoral research
You could be considered for a studentship or scholarship to help you study at Bath.
Studentships and scholarships
Depending on your area of study, you could be considered for different funding opportunities.
There are three main elements of funding for Doctoral Research:
Tuition fees
The cost of research, sometimes called the training support fund (TSF). This amount varies by discipline and project and should be discussed with your potential supervisor
Stipend, which is to cover your living costs and personal expenses
Scholarships can provide funds for all or just some of these costs, so please ensure you understand what the scholarship is covering before applying or accepting.
When considering funding you should also consider any costs associated with moving to Bath, e.g. relocation expenses and, if you require a visa to study in the UK, visa fees and the immigration health surcharge (IHS). The majority of scholarships do not cover these costs.
If you are an international student, you should also note that, in order to be considered for the majority of our studentships, you must have met the English language requirement for the programme before the application deadline (unless otherwise stated). Please check the English language requirement webpage to ensure you meet requirements before you apply.

Research with Impact Scholarships
Our generous community supports the leaders of tomorrow to research global challenges through philanthropic gifts funding doctoral scholarships. The Scholarships are aligned with research in the areas of sustainability; health and wellbeing; and digital.
Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships
High achieving international students may be eligible for a reduction in their tuition fees through the Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship Scheme.
International funding
If you're a student from outside the UK, you may be eligible for a scholarship or country-specific funding.
If you are an overseas applicant and you can demonstrate excellence in academic achievement, you may be eligible for a Vice Chancellorâs International Scholarship.

Further international sponsorship opportunities
Alternative funding
You can look for funding from sources other than those offered by the University. Trusts and charities can make awards for fees, maintenance, or research costs to any student, regardless of subject or nationality.
The Alternative Guide to Postgraduate Funding Online helps you explore alternative sources of funding. It contains a database of funding opportunities, comprehensive guidance, and tools to help you prepare a winning grant application.
The Guide is free for all University of Bath students and staff to use. If you are a prospective student and would like to access the site, you will need to request a PIN from Student Support.
Request a PIN from studentsupport@bath.ac.uk
Funding opportunities for current students
If you're a current Doctoral student, there are a range of funding opportunities available to you.
To find out more, visit our Doctoral Resource Hub.
Contact us
If you have any questions about funding for your doctoral study, get in touch.
